title: Philippine wildfire-onset label audit (Mindanao-first)
target_label: New wildfire start in a 5 km square during the next Philippine 24 hours
stronger_label_warning: Evidence currently supports at most 'reported fire incident' after an FOI ingest — not verified ignition onset. Do not publish a forecast under the stronger onset label until onset time and wildfire class are present.

sources.name: Vela configured wildfire-report lookup
sources.notes: No verified wildfire-incident source is configured for Vela yet (for example an agency incident feed with location and date).

sources.name: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) via eFOI
sources.geographic_coverage: FOI releases are request-specific (city/province/region). No open nationwide Mindanao wildfire-onset geocode feed is mounted in Vela.
sources.date_coverage: varies by FOI request; not loaded here
sources.event_definition: Often mixed fire incidents (structural, grass, forest). Forest-fire subsets appear in some FOI replies but are not automatically downloadable.
sources.coordinate_precision: Frequently address/barangay level; coordinates often require manual geocoding.
sources.start_vs_discovery: Report time / alarm time is common; true ignition onset is usually unknown.
sources.reporting_completeness: Incomplete for rural wildfires; cannot support square-day negative labels nationwide.
sources.notes: Example successful FOI pages exist (e.g. Davao City forest-fire request #BFP-338191405957), but attachments are not in this repository and are not an open API. Treating as inaccessible for training until a licensed table is filed under data/labels/philippines_onset.

sources.name: DENR / local DRRM wildfire or forest-fire bulletins
sources.geographic_coverage: irregular public bulletins; not a square-day registry
sources.reporting_completeness: not adequate for negative training examples
sources.notes: No machine-readable DENR Mindanao onset extract is present in the repo.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS / local observation store (satellite heat)
sources.event_definition: Hot pixel / heat detection — NOT a verified wildfire start
sources.start_vs_discovery: acquisition time of heat, not ignition onset
sources.duplicates: deduplicated in observation store by platform×time×lat×lon
sources.notes: Usable as issue-time features (prior heat, pass timing). Must not be used as positive onset labels or as proof of no wildfire.

uncertain_locations: all candidate agency sources until geocoded microdata arrives
uncertain_onset_dates: all candidate agency sources until onset≠discovery is verified
publish_blocker: 0 usable unique wildfire starts and 0 square-days with credible reporting coverage. Negatives are not supported. Vela will not publish an onset percentage.
next_runnable_step: File a Mindanao onset CSV/GeoJSON under data/labels/philippines_onset/ with the missing fields above (BFP FOI microdata or DENR/LDRRMO extract), then re-run `python -m scripts.audit_philippines_onset_labels` and `python -m scripts.train_philippines_onset`.
